svg.title: Flare SM70 KV pool capacity
svg.desc: KV pool at memory limit 31G with 4 agents on one Tesla V100 PCIe 32 GB: 98,304 tokens before replay-commit (2026-10-21) and 131,584 tokens with replay-commit (2026-10-22), +33,280 tokens (+33.9 %). Four prompts of 22.4k to 30.2k tokens, 110,022 prompt tokens in total, stay resident with zero evictions. Source: BENCHMARKS-SM70.md, STATUS.md lines 49 and 65.
